crewNotes.text: IMPORTANT: do not carry alcohol into the Maldives - it is prohibited and will be confiscated at the airport (available only at resorts). Pork is also restricted. Compiled from Maldives Customs guidance, pending final authority review.

prohibitedItems.text: Importing alcohol is prohibited - alcohol bought on board or in transit duty-free shops is confiscated on arrival (it is available only on resort islands). Importing pork and pork products without prior approval is also prohibited.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
